item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:55 AM 16 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Sorsogon(Donsol, CityOfSorsogon, Casiguran), #Albay(Jovellar, LegazpiCity, Manito, Guinobatan, Camalig, Daraga, PioDuran), #Masbate(Balud, Mandaon, Aroroy, Claveria), #Romblon(SanJose, SantaFe, Looc, Ferrol and Alcantara) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Sorsogon(Pilar, Castilla, Magallanes and Juban) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
